package nest

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"testing"
)

const reviewFailedBuildKind entity.EntityKind = 197

var reviewBuildRejected = errors.New("review: component initialization rejected")

func init() {
	entity.RegisterEntityBuilder(&entity.EntityBuilderParam{
		Category: 1, Kind: reviewFailedBuildKind,
		DaoBuilders: []entity.DaoBuilderFunc{func() entity.DaoInterface { return &rollbackTestDao{} }},
		Builder: func(p *entity.EntityCreateParam) (entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
			dao := p.Dao["rollback_test"].(*rollbackTestDao)
			dao.Value = 99
			if err := MarkPersist(dao, 1); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return nil, reviewBuildRejected
		},
	})
}
func TestReviewFailedEntityBuildMustNotPersistItsDAO(t *testing.T) {
	manager := entity.NewEntityManager()
	id := mustBuildCastID(t, 39101, 1, reviewFailedBuildKind)
	committer := &recordingCommitter{}
	err := entity.WithGuardScope("review_failed_create", func(scope *entity.GuardScope) error {
		_, err := RunIsolatedTransaction(context.Background(), committer, "review_failed_create", func() (any, error) {
			_, err := manager.Create(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Id: id, Category: 1, Kind: reviewFailedBuildKind})
			if !errors.Is(err, reviewBuildRejected) {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected creation error: %v", err)
			}
			return nil, nil // 业务处理了创建失败，继续完成其他工作。
		})
		return err
	})
	if manager.Get(id) != nil {
		t.Fatal("failed entity was published")
	}
	for _, mutation := range committer.record.Mutations {
		if mutation.Key.ID == id {
			t.Fatalf("failed Create persisted an unpublished entity: transaction err=%v, mutation=%+v", err, mutation)
		}
	}
}

func TestReviewFailedBuildInNestHandler(t *testing.T) {
	for _, propagate := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "handled_error"
		if propagate {
			name = "propagated_error"
		}
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			manager := entity.NewEntityManager()
			pilots := addPilots(t, manager, 39200, 1)
			id := mustBuildCastID(t, 39201, 1, reviewFailedBuildKind)
			committer := &recordingCommitter{}
			mgr := NewEngine(NestOptionWithGetter(entity.NewManagerAccess(manager)), NestOptionWithTransactionCommitter(committer))
			handler := NewHandlerName("review_failed_builder_" + name)
			mgr.MustRegisterHandlerWithMeta(handler, func([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, []any, ...HandlerOption) (any, error) {
				_, err := manager.Create(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Id: id, Category: 1, Kind: reviewFailedBuildKind})
				if !errors.Is(err, reviewBuildRejected) {
					return nil, errors.New("fixture: unexpected creation result")
				}
				if propagate {
					return nil, err
				}
				return "creation rejected", nil
			}, HandlerMeta{Rollback: RollbackState, Durability: DurabilityStrict})
			if err := mgr.Start(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer mgr.Shutdown(context.Background())
			_, err := mgr.Request(context.Background(), handler, pilots[0], nil)
			if propagate && !errors.Is(err, reviewBuildRejected) {
				t.Fatalf("propagated error=%v", err)
			}
			if manager.Get(id) != nil {
				t.Fatal("failed entity was published")
			}
			for _, m := range committer.record.Mutations {
				if m.Key.ID == id {
					t.Fatalf("failed entity DAO committed by real Nest handler: err=%v key=%+v payload=%s", err, m.Key, m.Data)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
